title: Snow-square duet: you and a partner dance under the holiday lights
summary: Two people meet in a snowy town square under strings of holiday lights, step together, turn into a hug and finish facing each other.
why: AI Trend Club's list, updated November 14, 2026, traces a snowy couple dance to a TikTok posted November 8: two dancers meet in a snow-covered square under holiday lights, step together, hug, then finish face to face. It had about 959K views by November 13. Our earlier holiday dance pack was a pyjama routine by the tree; this one is outdoors, slow and romantic.
steps: Pick your partner: a partner, friend, kid or pet. Get their OK before you use their photo.
Take one full-body photo of each person, head to feet, in a winter coat if you have one, in good light.
Upload both photos to an image-to-video tool and paste the main prompt. Ask for no music.
Add a soft holiday song from the app's music library and post it with one short line.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the snow-square duet
prompts.text: Use photo 1 as the person on the left and photo 2 as the person on the right. Keep both faces and body shapes exactly as in the photos. They wear warm winter coats, scarves and boots. Setting: a small town square at night, fresh snow on the ground, snow falling gently, strings of warm white holiday lights overhead and a lit tree in the background. One slow camera that drifts around them, full body, vertical 9:16, 15 seconds. They walk toward each other from opposite sides and reach out their hands. They take a few slow steps together, turn under each other's arm, then pull into a warm hug. They step apart and end facing each other, smiling, as snow falls. Soft, cinematic, gentle. No music, no text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: you and your dog
prompts.text: Use photo 1 as me and photo 2 as my dog. Keep my face and my dog's colours and markings exactly the same. We are in a snowy town square at night under strings of warm holiday lights, with light snow falling. One slow drifting camera, full body, vertical, 15 seconds. I walk in from the left and my dog bounds in from the right. We do a slow little dance: I hold its front paws and we step side to side, then turn in a circle. I kneel and it jumps into a big hug. We end nose to nose in the snow. Sweet and funny. No music, no text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Use photo 1 and photo 2 as two of our team members. Keep their faces exactly as in the photos. They wear warm winter coats and scarves and stand in the snowy square just outside our [type of business, for example: café], with its window glowing and holiday lights strung overhead. One slow drifting camera, full body, vertical, 15 seconds. They meet in the middle, take a few slow steps together, turn, share a quick friendly hug, then both turn and point at the warm shop window as snow falls. Cosy and cheerful. No music, no text, no logos.

tips: Full-body photos with feet showing give smoother steps and turns.
Coats help: the AI keeps outfits steadier when the photo already looks wintry.
If the hug looks stiff, ask for "a slower, softer hug that lasts two seconds".
Only use photos of people who said yes to being in the video.
